title.en: Dua for reappearance of Imam-e-Asr (a) on Friday, Eid-ul-Fitr & Eid-ul-Qurbaan.
title.rurdu: Dua Imam-e-Asr (a) ke zahoor ki, Roz-e-Juma, Eid-ul-Fitr & Eid-ul-Qurbaan.
title.urdu: روز جمعہ، عید فطر اور عید قربان امام عصر(عج) کے ظہور کی دُعا۔

desc.en: It has been narrated from Imam Mohammad Baqir (a) that: On the days of Friday, Eid ul Fitr and Qurbaan, while exiting your house, say…
desc.rurdu: Hazrat Imam Muhammad Baqir (a) irshaad farmate hai Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-e-Qurbaan aur Roz-e-Juma jab namaz mein jaane ke liye aamaada ho to kaho…
desc.urdu: حضرت امام محمد باقر فرماتے ہیں جمعہ عید فطر عید قربان کے دن جب نماز کے لئے جانے کا ارادہ کریں تو کہیں۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَنْ تَهَیَّاَ فِیْ هٰذَا الْیَوْمِ، اَوْ تَعَبَّأَ اَوْ اَعَدَّ وَاسْتَعَدَّ لِوِفَادَۃٍ اِلٰی مَخْلُوْقٍ، رَجَاۗئَ رِفْدِهٖ وَجَاۗئِزَتِهٖ وَنَوَافِلِهٖ، فَاِلَیْكَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ كَانَتْ وِفَادَتِیْ وَتَهْیِئَتِیْ وَاِعْدَادِیْ وَاسْتِعْدَادِیْ رَجَاۗئَ رِفْدِكَ، وَجَوَاۗئِزِكَ وَنَوَافِلِكَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA MAN TAHAYYA-A FEE HAAZAL YAWME, AW TA-A’BBA-A AW A-A’DDA WAS-TA-A’DDA LE WEFAA-DATIN ILAA MAKHLOO-QIN, RAJAA-A RIF-DEHI WA-JAA-E-ZATE-HI WA NAWAA-FELE-HI, FA-ILAIY-KA YAA SAIYYE-DEE KAA-NAT WEFAA-DATEE WA TAHYE-ATEE WA E’DAA-DEE WAS-TE’DAA-DEE RAJAA-A RIFDE-KA, WA JAWAA-E-ZEKA WA NAWAA-FELE-KA.

trans.en: O Allah, whoever prepares himself or makes himself available on this day for meeting one of Your creations with the hope of reward, grace and blessings from him, then O my Master, my departure and preparation and availability and presence towards you is with the hope of Your rewards and forgiveness.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ وَخِیَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَعَلِیِّ اَمِیْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَوَصِیِّ رَسُوْلِكَ، وَصَلِّ یَا رَبِّ عَلٰی اَئِمَّۃِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، اَلْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَیْنِ وَعَلِیٍّ وَمُحَمَّدٍ وَجَعْفَرٍ وَمُوْسٰى وَعَلِيٍّ وَمُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلِيٍّ وَالْحَسَنِ وَالْحُجَّةِ، الْقَوَّامِ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN A’BDE-KA WA RASOOLE-KA WA KHE-YARA-TEKA MIN KHALQE-KA, WA A’LIYYIN AMEERIL MOMENEENA WA WASIYYE RASOOLE-KA, WA SALLE YAA RABBE A’LAA AIMMA-TIL MOMENEENA, AL-HASANE WAL HUSAINE WA ALIYYIN WA MOHAMMADIN WA JA’FAREEN WA MOOSAA WA ALIYYIN WA MOHAMMADIN WA ALIYYIN WAL HASANE WAL HUJJA-TIL QAWAA-ME.

trans.en: O Allah, bless Your slave, Your messenger, the chosen one from Your worshippers, Mohammad (s.a.w.a), and Ali (a.s) and the successors of Your Prophet, and O Allah, bless the leaders of the faithful, Imam Hasan (a.s), Imam Husain (a.s), Imam Sajjad (a.s) and Imam Baqir (a.s) then take the names of all the Imams in sequence until you reach the name of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s).

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَعْ لَهٗ فَتْحًا یَسِیْرًا، وَانْصُرْهُ نَصْرًا عَزِیْزًا۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِظْهِرْ بِهٖ دِیْنَكَ وَسُنَّۃَ رَسُوْلِكَ، حَتّٰی لَا یَسْتَخْفِیَ بِشَیْءٍ مِنَ الْحَقِّ مَخَافَۃَ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْخَلْقِ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUM-MAF TA’ LAHU FAT-HAN YASEE-RAN, WAN-SURHO NAS-RAN A’ZEE-ZAN. ALLAAHUMMA IZ-HIR BEHI DEENA-KA WA SUNNA-TA RASOOLE-KA, HATTAA LAA YAS-TAKH-FEYA BE-SHAIY-IN MENAL HAQQE MA-KHAA-FATA AHA-DIM MINAL KHALQE.

trans.en: O Allah, provide him with easy relief, and support him with dignified support. O Allah, make Your religion and Your Prophet’s tradition apparent through him so that no right is concealed due to the fear of anyone.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَرْغَبُ اِلَیْكَ فِیْ دَوْلَۃٍ كَرِیْمَۃٍ تُعِزُّ بِهَا الْاِسْلَامَ وَاَهْلَهٗ، وَتُذِلُّ بِهَا النِّفَاقَ وَاَهْلَهٗ، وَتَجْعَلُنَا فِیْهَا مِنَ الدُّعَاۃِ اِلٰی طَاعَتِكَ وَالْقَادَۃِ اِلٰی سَبِیْلِكَ وَتَرْزُقُنَا بِهَا كَرَامَۃَ الدُّنْیَا وَالْآخِرَۃِ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا اَنْكَرْنَا مِنْ حَقٍّ فَعَرِّ فُنَاهُ وَمَا قَصُرْنَا عَنْهُ فَبَلِّغْنَاهُ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA NAR-GA’BO ILAIY-KA FEE DAWLA-TIN KAREE-MATIN TO-I’ZZO BE-HAL ISLAAMA WA AHLA-HU, WA TO-ZILLO BE-HAN NEFAA-QA WA AH-LAHU, WA TAJ-A’LONAA FEE-HAA MINAD DOAA’TE ILAA TAA-A’TE-KA WAL QAA-DATE ILAA SABEELE-KA WA TARZO-QONAA BEHAA KARAA-MA-TAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHE-RATE. ALLAAHUMMA MAA AN-KARNAA MIN HAQQIN FA-A’RRE FONAA-HO WA MAA QA-SORNAA A’N-HO FA-BALLIGH-NAAHO.

trans.en: O Allah, we turn towards You with eagerness towards the noble nation through which You shall glorify Islam and the Muslims, and humiliate hypocrisy and the hypocrites; and regard us in that nation as the inviters towards Your obedience and as the leader towards Your path, and make the honor of this world and the hereafter our share. O Allah, make us aware of those truth and realities which we did not recognize, and provide us with all that to which we couldn’t have access.

desc.en: Here, pray for the Master of Time (a), and curse his enemies. Then ask for your wishes and recite your last verses in the following manner…
desc.rurdu: Ab Khuda se Imam-e-Asr (a) ke liye dua aur dushman par nafreen (laanat) karo, aur apni haajat talab karo, aur phir is tarah se kaho…
desc.urdu: اور خدا سے اس کے لئے دعا مانگو اور ان کے دشمن پر نفرین بھیجو اور اپنی حاجت کا خدا سے سوال کرو اور آخری کلام یہ کہو۔۔۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اسْتَجِبْ لَنَا۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ تَذَكَّرَ فِیْهِ فَیَدَّكَّرَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUM-MAS TAJAB LANAA. ALLAAHUM-MAJ A’L-NAA MIMMAN TAZAK-KARA FEEHE FA-YADDAK-KARA.

trans.en: O Allah, accept (our prayers) for us; O Lord, regard us among the reminders and the reminded ones.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
